items.raw_source: recomputed from last MovType-261 date per material-plant using the brief's thresholds
items.root_cause: The curated table classifies 1,195 lines as OBSOLETE whose own DAYS_SINCE_LAST_CONSUMPTION is in the 181-365 bucket — i.e. NON_MOVING under the brief's rule. The curated age column itself agrees with RAW on 100% of those 1,195 lines (DSLC_MATCHES_RAW = 1,195/1,195), so the ageing is identical and only the NM/OBS cut-point differs: the curated rule applies a threshold below 365 days. A further 4 lines are classified OBSOLETE with no 261 movement ever; the brief's rule makes never-issued = NON_MOVING. 1,195 + 4 = 1,199.
items.impact: ACTIVE and SLOW_MOVING are unaffected, so the SMI KPI is safe. NMI and the Obsolete KPI shift materially depending on which rule is used.
items.resolution: Dashboard must compute NM/SM/OBS from the brief's rule (RAW) and display the CURATED figure alongside it with this warning. Neither value is altered in HANA.

items.raw_source: trailing-12m net demand / 365 x DIM_MATERIAL.PLANNED_DELIVERY_DAYS + curated SAFETY_STOCK_QTY
items.status: DIFFERENCE — within tolerance in aggregate, not line by line
items.root_cause: Two drivers. (a) Lead time: the RAW recomputation uses PLANNED_DELIVERY_DAYS only, while the brief's rule is MAX(planned, actual) + median PR-to-PO — so the RAW ROP here is a lower bound and the true figure will move once actual lead time and PR-to-PO latency are joined in. (b) Demand basis: curated TRAILING_12M_DEMAND_QTY matches ISSUES-ONLY (261) on 25,925 of 34,717 lines but NET (261-262) on only 18,927 — the curated trailing demand is closer to a gross-issues measure than to the brief's net definition. Curated T12 sum 2,091,095.4 vs RAW net 1,770,896.3 (diff -320,199.1, -15.3%) vs RAW issues-only 1,815,618.3 (diff -275,477.1, -13.2%). Neither matches exactly, so a third adjustment (likely a different 12-month window or a backcast inclusion) is also present.
items.resolution: The dashboard's ROP must be recomputed from RAW once actual lead time and median PR-to-PO are available (step 2); the +/-20% ROP flag is driven off that recomputation. Curated ROP is shown as the SAP-master comparison column.

warnings.message: CURATED movement class disagrees with the brief's rule on 1,199 of 34,717 lines (3.45%): 1,195 NM-aged lines are flagged OBSOLETE and 4 never-issued lines are flagged OBSOLETE rather than NON_MOVING. NMI and Obsolete KPIs are affected; ACTIVE and SLOW_MOVING are not.

Curated ROP is 3.64% below a RAW recomputation, and only 16,340 of 34,717 lines agree within +/-20%. Curated trailing-12m demand behaves like gross 261 issues rather than net 261-262. Do not treat curated ROP as the brief's ROP.
PLANT_ID='ALL_PLANTS' exists in DIM_PLANT and INVENTORY_KPI_MONTHLY as a pre-aggregated rollup equal to the sum of the six physical plants. Every plant filter and sum must exclude it.
4 of the 34,717 classified material-plant pairs have no 261 movement at all in or before the period. They are never-issued and must be classed NON_MOVING per the brief.

Material group LUBRICANTS has months with no 261/262 movement at all; its series carries nulls rather than zeros in step1/aggregates/type_group_month.json. Forecasting must treat the gap explicitly, not impute it.

uncomputable.item: Lead time = MAX(planned, actual) + median PR-to-PO
uncomputable.reason: Only DIM_MATERIAL.PLANNED_DELIVERY_DAYS was resolved in this step. Actual lead time needs FACT_GOODS_RECEIPT joined to FACT_PURCHASE_ORDER, and median PR-to-PO needs FACT_PURCHASE_REQUISITION joined to FACT_PURCHASE_ORDER — and both PR and PO exist in a base and a _V2 variant whose precedence is not yet established. Deferred to step 2 rather than guessed. Every ROP figure in this file is therefore a planned-lead-time lower bound and is labelled as such.
